Adri Vega: hey team, starting Tues as SDR. Can someone help with: CRM seat, Dialpad softphone, Gong access, AE/SDR playbook edit rights, and the Q1 target list for EMEA? thanks!
Kara Simmons: welcome Adri! send your work email and i'll request CRM + EMEA list. do you need edit on both AE and SDR playbooks or just SDR?
Adri Vega: adri.vega@redwood.ai. SDR playbook edit only. also would love the 2-minute elevator script and the outbound sequences.
Miles Ortega: ill take Dialpad + Gong. Dialpad tip: enable voicemail->email and set caller ID to your assigned local number. Gong: watch the "SDR Cold Intro" clips first.
Provisioning Bot: Ticket PRV-2811 opened for CRM seat, Dialpad, Gong, playbook perms. ETA 10 hours.
Kara Simmons: CRM invite sent and added you to saved view "EMEA - SDR Targets". Also uploaded target CSV to Sales Drive > EMEA.
Adri Vega: i see the CRM invite, but playbook edit still read-only.
Kara Simmons: granting edit perms now. also added you to #sdr-ramp and scheduled a 1:1 buddy shadow with Priya Thurs 9am.
Miles Ortega: Gong invite sent. Shared playlist: "SDR Ramp - Week 1" and dropped the elevator script snippet in the playbook under Quick Scripts.
Adri Vega: got it — playbook edit works and playlist received. one more: where are demo creds for quick product walk-throughs?
Kara Simmons: demo creds are in 1Password under Sales/Demos > EMEA. i assigned the staging org to your CRM account.
Provisioning Bot: Update PRV-2811: All seats provisioned and permissions updated. Ticket closed. :white_check_mark:
Adri Vega: amazing, thank you all. i'll post any follow-ups here and DM if i get stuck on the CRM views.
